predictions.articleTitle: Norway vs Wales Prediction & Match Analysis: Haaland vs Wales's Reshuffled Defense — xG Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Norway hold a clear home advantage with Erling Haaland and Martin Ødegaard confirmed to start against a Wales side missing suspended Ben Cabango and Sorba Thomas plus injured striker Kieffer Moore.
possibilityAssessment: Norway Home Win driven by a 1.42 vs 0.69 xG/match gap and confirmed full-strength front four against a depleted Welsh backline (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals and 2:1 Home Win backed by Norway's 100% Over 2.5 record in Group A4 and 0% clean-sheet rate alongside Wales's 1.69 xGA/match (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
2:0 Clean-Sheet Home Win hedge if Wales's Group A4 away scoring drought (0 goals in 2 road trips without Kieffer Moore) persists in Oslo (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Haaland and Ødegaard face a Cabango-less Wales defense at Ullevaal.

spf.comment: Norway's +270 Elo edge, 1.42 xG/match, and confirmed starting quartet justify a single Home Win over a Wales side missing Cabango, Thomas, and Moore.

over_under.comment: Norway have gone Over 2.5 in all four Group A4 matches while Wales concede 1.69 xGA/match, pushing lineup-adjusted expectancy above 2.5 goals.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Norway's two-goal home ceiling against a weakened defense plus their own clean-sheet vulnerability, while 2:0 covers Wales's zero-goal away trend.

goals.comment: Three goals align with Norway's 4-for-4 Over 2.5 Group A4 trend, while two goals represent the top unadjusted Poisson bucket if Wales fail to score.

bqc.comment: Norway score two-thirds of their goals in the first half (Win-Win), while Wales's 3-of-4 half-time draw record makes a second-half breakthrough (Draw-Win) the main alternative.
